Hexagon tiling of region

Source: R/hexagon_tiling.R
cv_hex.Rd

Both the interface and function name may change in future versions.

Partitions the region based on the hexagon tiling

Input:

Usage

cv_hex(samplers, cellsize = 0.5, n_group = 3, ...)

Arguments

samplers

A sf object containing region for which partitions to be created

cellsize

hexagon cellsize, see sf::st_make_grid() description

n_group

number of cv folds.

...

Passed on to fm_nonconvex_hull(), e.g. resolution

Value

a hexagonal partition covering the samplers object, with a group integer variable indicating the fold assignment, 1, 2, ..., n_group.

Author

Man Ho Suen

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  bnd <- gorillas_sf$boundary
  hex_cv <- cv_hex(bnd, cellsize = 2, n_group = 3, resolution = 100)
  plot(hex_cv)

  chess <- cv_partition(bnd, resolution = 1.5, chess = TRUE)
  plot(chess$black$geometry, col = "black")
}
